name: @spexcode/spec-desktop
description: SpexCode desktop shell — a window over `spex dashboard`. Deliberately OUTSIDE the root workspaces: `npm install` at the repo root must not pull ~150 MB of Electron on a contributor who is not working on the shell.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('spec-desktop: run npm start from this directory; SPEXCODE_DESKTOP_CWD picks the project to serve.')"
